name: expense-splitter
description: Split the costs of a group trip, dinner or shared flat and settle up with the fewest transfers. List who paid what — one payer or several — and who shares each expense: everyone, everyone except someone, weighted shares like “A*2”, an exact amount, or an extra on top of an equal share. See what each person paid, owes and gets back, and the shortest list of “who pays whom”. Export a settlement workbook and a clean image to send to the group chat. Runs locally; no account or API keys.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 多人旅行、聚餐、合租的花费一起算：谁付了多少（可以多人一起付），每笔由谁分摊——全部人、除某人以外、按份数（如“A*2”）、某人正好承担多少、或在平分之外多承担一些。立即看到每人已付、应摊和差额，以及最少几笔转账就能结清。导出结算 Excel 和一张可以直接发到群里的结算图片。在本地运行，不用登录，无需 API 密钥。
